request.instructions: One illustrated educational page. Warm cream, forest green and burnt orange. No raster images or invented measurements.

pages.title: Healthy soil holds water for roots

facts: Organic matter helps soil retain moisture.
Water is held in spaces between soil particles.

pages.instructions: Create an original custom SVG plant-and-soil cutaway as the central focal illustration. Show the plant above ground, connected roots below, organic matter and water spaces. Use hand-drawn strokes and distinct meaningful shapes. SVG artwork only: no visible <text> nodes. Place the supplied labels and facts as separate native editable text in reserved side lanes; use short callouts only where endpoints clarify a part. Reserve height for wrapped headings and explanations. Use safe self-contained markup with viewBox and element-prefixed IDs. Preserve the exact supplied facts.
